record.viewport: 1512 CSS px wide desktop, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the six accepted deviations, the render matches the reference: the header, picture, name, purpose line, Quick chat button and Overview tab have the same content, sizes and states.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels: the render has no Inbox, Queue, Context drift or Chats panel under the tabs; the page is empty below the tabs. Those panels are built in later issues.
accepted_deviations.note: Below the tabs the render shows only the starfield background, from y 202 to the bottom of the page.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs: the render's tab row shows Overview and Ideas, where the reference shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA. Only the tabs of shipped increments show.
accepted_deviations.note: Overview is selected in both and has the same size (about 109 x 32). Ideas has a lightbulb icon and shows the unselected state.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name: the purpose line starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the reference has a person's name. A secret-scan rule keeps the name out of the code.
accepted_deviations.note: The longer wording still fits on one line, which ends at about x 1079.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top: the back row, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than in the reference, and the purpose sits 4 px further under the name. The design's 28 px top has no spacing token.
accepted_deviations.note: The back link, picture (72-136 against 76-140) and name sit 4 px higher. The Quick chat button on the same top row also sits 4 px higher (24-56 against 28-60), and I count that as part of this deviation. The purpose line sits about 5 px higher, not 4 px further under the name: the gap from the name to the purpose looks the same as in the reference, within about 1 px. The tab row has not moved (170-202 in both), so the gap above the tabs is about 4-5 px larger. That follows from this deviation.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rail: the left rail is the app's shared rail in its default order: Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts, Toolkit and More. The reference draws an older rail with Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The page never changes the shared rail.
accepted_deviations.note: Artifacts and Toolkit sit between Projects and More. Projects is selected in both.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Sides: the content starts 4 px further right than in the reference (40 px sides where the reference has 36). No spacing token is 36.
accepted_deviations.note: The back link, picture and tabs start 4 px further right. The Quick chat button's right edge is 4 px further left (1472 against 1476), which matches the 40 px side on the right.

limits: Below the tabs the render shows only the starfield background (accepted deviation A1), so I could not compare the panel regions.

The full-size images may have been shown scaled down when shown to me. In the lower half, where there were no 1:1 crops, I could not check differences under about 2 px. That area is empty in the render.
I measured vertical positions in the header to about 1 px.
